act_title: The Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993
title: Appointment of  Chairperson and** **[7][Members] of State Commission
text:
22. Appointment of Chairperson and [Members] of State Commission.—(1) The Chairperson

and [Members] shall be appointed by the Governor by warrant under his hand and seal:

Provided that every appointment under this sub-section shall be made after obtaining the

recommendation of a Committee consisting of—

(a) the Chief Minister —chairperson;

(b) Speaker of the Legislative Assembly —member;

(c) Minister in-charge of the Department

of Home in that State

(d) Leader of the Opposition in the

Legislative Assembly

—member;

—member:
